notes.title: SMOOTH SAILING
notes.notes:
[h1]Ships Rework[/h1]
You asked, so here it is! After considering your feedback, I agree that waiting for the ships can be tedious, especially in the late game. So say hello to your new friend: Ship-calling Bell! I you ring it, very soon the next ship will arrive! There were also a change to rafts, now they allow you to manually put one down. I hope you will enjoy this update! But if you were a fan of the previous system, don't worry, the bell is optional, as the ships and rafts still sail the same without it! You can tell me what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44150114/4b3f246aef98ff9e12fac668cbcb9169e2f5717e.png[/img]

[h1]Speed Indicators[/h1]
Now when you play, you can see little arrows at the top of the screen. I noticed some of you sometimes don't notice things that speed up or slow down the turtle, so they will help you with that!

[h1]And More![/h1]
Additionally:
[list]
[*] Options menu in the main menu (finally)
[*] Fade outs work a bit better
[/list]

Again, if you've played and enjoyed the game, please leave a Steam review, it's the best thing you can do to help the game!

Take care,
Simon

notes.title: ENDING WITH FASHION
notes.notes:
[h1]Ending Update[/h1]
Oh, I realllyyyy messed up. So, apparently, you cannot end the game. AT. ALL. And even worse. YOU LOSE ALL YOU UNSAVED PROGRESS AT THE END. I'm extremely sorry to everyone who experienced that. The fix to that is already live, and now you can finish the game. Also, if you have lost any progress, please contact me over at Discord so I can try to help you regain it.

[h1]Fashion Update[/h1]
And besides that: I noticed that NPCs in Grain Plains and Salrise look very similar, so with help of my lovely gf, we made sure every one is unique. Please let me know which one do you think is the most stylish!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44150114/ec77fb9c753f7195ae89e0b275a091d09b7dc6b6.jpg[/img]
[h1]And More![/h1]
Development of our Turtle game does not end here! In the near future I'm planning to add bugfixes, QoL and some features I had no time to implement before premiere. Ship haters: rejoice! I'm gonna have something for you soon! There are even maybe plans for some post-game content? Who knows.

Again, if you've played and enjoyed the game, please leave a Steam review, it's the best thing you can do to help the game! And maybe even tell you friends about it? But who am I to tell you what to do...

Take care,
Simon

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello! I hope everyone is enjoying their adventure in Tongs Delta!
I got some feedback and noticed some bugs, so I just published a patch.
Changes:
- Fixed automove stopping too easily on controller
- Fixed "I gathered ther fruit" typo
- Fixed most signposts being blank
- Fixed using sleeping bag on controller blocking the camera
- Added Camera Speed setting
- Added Mounting/Unmounting input to Controls menu

Thank you everybody for playing the game, and if you have any feedback or encountered bugs, please let me know!
Best place for that is our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/qWmPRKqTfk]https://discord.gg/qWmPRKqTfk[/url]
Take care,
Simon

notes.title: LITTLE ODYSSEY is releasing on 17th of MAY!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44150114/45aae5f6389584eea4f11e05785e3746bca1bd5a.gif[/img]
Hello Travelers!
I'm very happy to announce that Little Odyssey, project I've been working for over a year, will be releasing on Steam on [b]17th of May[/b]. So be prepared to embark on your relaxing desert journey in less than a month!

[h2]Q&A[/h2]
[olist]
[*]How much will it cost?
[b]The game will cost 14.99$ at launch, with additional 30% launch discount[/b]
[*]What platforms will the game support?
[b]On launch, you will be able to play the game on both Windows and Linux[/b]
[*]What languages does the game support?
[b]On launch, the game will support only English[/b]
[/olist]

But the launch is only the beginning; I have already few bigger updates planned (not forgetting about fixes for all the bugs you will find) and maybe even some bigger expansion is  on the horizon...

So if you haven't already, I will ask you once again to [b]Wishlist the game[/b] - it's free and is the best way in which you can support the project and help reach better launch visibility, and by that helping me support the game longer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434590


Take care,
Simon 💖

notes.title: Little Odyssey
notes.notes: You are in the middle of a big fantasy desert and you have one mission: deliver packages. But how will you manage this? With help of your Giant Magical Turtle! In Little Odyssey, you will be traveling between settlements in this open-world on your big friend and helping its inhabitants. Relax with the soothing artstyle and relaxing music, and experience stories of Tongs Delta people. Welcome Traveler!

notes.title: Little Odyssey
notes.notes: Relax while traveling around a fantasy desert on your Giant Magical Turtle. Deliver packages and explore the world in your Little Odyssey!
